frameworks.use: Stage 2: keep skills mutually exclusive and together covering every agent-assigned activity.
Stage 3: sort each decision as big-bet, cross-cutting, delegated or ad hoc before setting the harness level. Only frequent, low-risk delegated decisions suit HL2 and above.
Stage 4: one-way door actions (payments, external sends, record deletion) always escalate to a human checkpoint.
Stages 3 and 4: every skill has one accountable human owner and a named escalation target.

agensia-harness/agensia-harness.reference_intro: Use these neutral design checks at the named steps. They do not replace evidence, authorisation, approval or the production prohibition.
